thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the nested work. If each choice restarts a full scan, time blows up. Name the cost before optimizing — interviewers want that honesty. Target after the insight: O(n).

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To count the number of good nodes in a binary tree, we can use a recursive depth-first search (DFS) approach. For each node, we keep track of the maximum value encountered on the path from the root to the current node. If the value of the current node is greater than or equal to the maximum value on the path, it is a good node. We increment the count and continue the DFS for the left and right subtrees.
